description: tdd-guard: blocks production-code edits and locks linter, formatter, type-check, CI and git hook settings while a tdd-flow cycle is in the RED phase, also when a shell command writes the file (tdd-guard-bash). push-gate: runs type check, lint, tests and a gitleaks scan before Claude runs git push or gh pr create, and blocks git commands that skip the hooks (--no-verify). register.tsx: the status pane (/tdd-status).
